title: neural-audio-bench results (CSV column specification)
description: Machine-readable specification of the result CSV columns (schema_version 2). CSVs are the primary result format; this document defines column order, types, and semantics for validators. See docs/results-schema.md for prose. Pre-release v1 files lack the first three columns.

const.status: ok | skipped | error — non-ok rows document why a combination produced no measurement; their numeric fields are zeros and must be ignored
const.mode: isolated only: throughput | callback ('-' on status rows)
const.dimension: contention only: scenario id (dim_a/dim_b/dim_c/custom); '_cb' suffix = full-callback row for the same configuration
const.median_ns: interpolated median of per-iteration (isolated) / per-callback (contention) wall-clock duration
const.hw_xruns: Core Audio overload count delta across the measurement window
const.inf_underruns: anira backends: callbacks where background inference output was not ready (summed over instances)
